content.user_title: Audit Paid Ad Accounts Before Scaling
content.value_statement: Scaling paid media without clean tracking, safe placements, and clear ROAS signals can waste budget. This skill turns exported account data into a SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK decision.
actual_capabilities: Scores Return, Offer, Audience, and Spend-efficiency using the ROAS benchmark.
Checks five veto conditions for tracking, attribution, claims, policy, and placement safety.
Produces a SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK decision before launch or budget increases.
Works from user-provided exports, including campaign, search terms, placements, GA4, and ecommerce data.
Creates an auditor handoff with scores, evidence, open loops, and recommended next skill.
limitations: Requires current account exports; missing data reduces certainty.
Does not connect to Google Ads or Meta APIs by itself.
Does not build campaigns, creatives, or landing pages.
Does not replace legal, platform policy, or finance review.

use_cases.title: Check Scale Readiness
use_cases.description: Audit ROAS quality, spend waste, and tracking before increasing budget.

use_cases.title: Review Client Accounts
use_cases.description: Create a consistent audit artifact for campaign health and next-step planning.

use_cases.title: Gate a Launch
use_cases.description: Run a go/no-go check before paid campaigns first go live.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Scale Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my paid ad account before scaling. Goal: DR. I will provide the campaign export, GA4 conversions, and placements report.

prompt_templates.title: Waste Diagnosis
prompt_templates.scenario: Find spend leaks in active campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Find why this account is wasting spend. Use my search terms report, campaign export, placements report, and ecommerce conversion export.

prompt_templates.title: Launch Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the launch go/no-go checklist for this new campaign. Check tracking, budget caps, bid strategy, negatives, creative approval, landing page, and placements.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Platform RQS Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full ROAS audit across Google Ads and Meta. Use my campaign exports, search terms, placements, GA4 traffic acquisition, ecommerce orders, and goal column. Identify vetoes, compute RQS, and give the final gate.

output_examples.input: Campaign and GA4 exports for a DR account before scaling.
output_examples.output: Result: FIX. Conversion tracking is partial, search terms include low-intent spend, and placements need review before budget increases.

output_examples.input: Pre-launch checklist for a new paid campaign.
output_examples.output: Result: NO-GO. Tracking verification and placement safety are incomplete. Resolve those items before launching.

output_examples.input: Google Ads, Meta, GA4, and ecommerce exports for one date range.
output_examples.output: Result: BLOCK. The same orders appear in multiple platform reports, and claims need substantiation before the account can scale.

best_practices: Provide exports from the same date range and currency.
State the goal column before scoring starts.
Separate user-facing findings from internal handoff fields.
anti_patterns: Treating platform ROAS as truth without checking order IDs.
Scaling before placements and claim substantiation are reviewed.
Passing missing data as clean data.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign exports, search terms, placements, GA4 traffic acquisition, and ecommerce conversion data when available.

faq.question: Can it audit Google Ads and Meta Ads?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review exported data from both platforms when date ranges and currencies are aligned.

faq.question: Does it require API access?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed to work from manually exported account data.

faq.question: What does BLOCK mean?
faq.answer: BLOCK means critical veto issues must be fixed before launch or scaling continues.

faq.question: Does it create new ads?
faq.answer: No. It audits readiness and routes creative work to the appropriate paid ads skill.

faq.question: Can it replace a compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It flags claim and policy risks, but legal and platform reviews remain separate.
